issues.issue: Judgment call: the label could mean the county-distributed motor vehicle tax (motor vehicle tax) and not pro-rate state aid. Same choice in detail[5] and detail[19].
Solid waste collection is a refuse service, so it could be utilities (refuse). The same question applies to detail[13].
This is a tax write-off, which is really an offset to property tax revenue. It is printed as an expenditure, so keeping it as spending is defensible.
